name: Dust & Gore Toggle
description:
Locally toggles Dust and Gore effects for lower visual overhead.
If you want to ensure a certain dust/particle remains visible even with dust disabled, you can add an exception for it:

-/de (dust id) to add a dust exception.
-/de list to list all exceptions.
-/de clear to clear all exceptions.
changelog: 0.1.0 - Initial Dust and Gore toggle migration.
